note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 by an independent agent after the annotation's home moved to plan/release/validation/spec-ipsec-fragment-receive-and-kernel-proof.md, whose AC-7 homes this row by name, and after TestRFC4301NonErrorICMPOutsideSelectorsIsDiscarded changed: its counter reader icmpErrSNMP(t, "InMsgs") became icmpInMsgs(t), the same Icmp InMsgs read with the same assertions (a parameter-only rename). RFC 4301 Section 5.2: "If an IPsec system receives an inbound packet on an SA and the packet's header fields are not consistent with the selectors for the SA, it MUST discard the packet." Tested: "it MUST discard the packet". Gap: "If an IPsec system receives an inbound packet on an SA". Producer: internal/component/ike/engine/child.go::installChildDataplane. The tunnel-mode test delivers an in-selector packet first, then for source, port and protocol misses requires no delivery and XfrmInStateMismatch +1 with XfrmInNoPols and XfrmInPolBlock unchanged, isolating the SA's own selector; the transport-mode test drops a port-6000 packet and an ICMP echo at the state (XfrmInStateMismatch +1); the non-error test drops an Echo Request whose outer headers miss the state selector (XfrmInStateMismatch +1, InMsgs not counting it) beside a delivered consistent error. Discard and delivery are distinct assertions. Single-pair fixtures only: a packet on one SA of a multi-pair or sibling set matching a sibling's selectors is unobserved. Scoped evidence only; zero whole-requirement credit.
